verdict.rationale: Docs and hands-on probes confirm the full non-interactive CI workflow: `terraform plan -out=FILE` saves a plan artifact (terraform-docs-30, terraform-probe-6), `terraform apply` executes that saved plan with `-auto-approve` skipping interactive confirmation (terraform-docs-3/17, terraform-probe-8), and machine-readable JSON output supports CI gating (terraform-docs-4/18, terraform-probe-7). A hands-on probe validated the entire plan→apply→drift-check→destroy loop running headlessly with proper exit codes. Missing for 10: no independent third-party CI pipeline case study explicitly combining these flags in a real pipeline beyond the local probe.
